scenarios: a tenant maps a forge repository to a session; a signed opened-issue delivery makes the canonical forge_webhook task with the issue as untrusted context, seen by cursor; unsigned/mis-signed/replayed/mis-installed/unmapped/cross-tenant deliveries are refused and audited; a delivery for a held session is relayed and the worker's Core makes the same events; a label-gated mapping waits for the label
proof: a signed GitHub App webhook makes the same canonical task the desktop makes from an issue, for the mapped tenant, once per delivery; the webhook path adds no second task model; the app's secret is held in memory only and never logged, stored or echoed.
audit: MISSING before: no webhook endpoint, no repository->tenant mapping; issue-to-task existed only on the local path (PX-010).
limitations: pull_request events accepted and ignored (PX-008/009 later); github only; issues.opened/labeled only; one webhook secret per process.
